annotations.title: Get a single empty leg flight by id

description: Look up one empty leg flight by its id and return its route, departure time, whole-aircraft price (taxes and fees shown at checkout), aircraft type, available seats, amenities and a booking link, as currently published. Returns a not-available message if the flight is no longer published.

flightId.description: The SkyAccess empty leg flight id, as given in the `flightId` field of a flight listing

name: get_flight
title: Get a single empty leg flight by id
